display_long_description:
Flight Tag is an early, unpolished multiplayer VR movement game that takes inspiration from the fast-paced locomotion made popular by Gorilla Tag. Built around hand-based movement, players run, climb, and launch themselves across the environment using only their arms, creating chaotic chases, skill-based escapes, and unpredictable tag moments. The core gameplay focuses on momentum, movement mastery, and quick reactions as players try to outmaneuver each other across different areas of the map.

In Flight Tag, players take on the role of taggers and runners in a wild, movement-focused environment where every match feels different. Whether you’re scaling objects, wall-bouncing through tight spaces, or juking opponents with quick turns and clever routes, the game rewards creativity and practice with its physics-driven movement system. The low-poly style theme adds personality to the experience while still keeping the gameplay focused on fast and competitive tagging.

Because the game is still in active development, Flight Tag is considered an unpolished project where new mechanics, maps, and features are constantly being tested and improved. Players may encounter experimental systems, unfinished visuals, or changes as the game evolves over time. The goal is to grow the experience while keeping the fun, chaotic movement that inspired it, while also building its own identity beyond the original concept that influenced it.
